{{Top|leg}}
'''Regall''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[MacroMotionMonitor]], Regall noted how they usually equipped a [[Cam droid/Legends|hovercam]] with a [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion tracker]] which gave them an edge in tight situations.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
